interpretation_boundary: Read-only dataset profiling and prediction-feasibility review. This is not a trained or validated water-level forecast and is not a validated flood prediction.

station_coverage.identity_definition: case-folded supplied station name + supplied State LGD Code + supplied District LGD Code; audit grouping only, not verified gauge IDs

time_coverage.timestamp_semantics: UNRESOLVED; Data Acquisition Time meaning not established

sampling_intervals.interval_basis: Elapsed time between unique parsed source timestamps. No timezone was added to naive timestamps; source event semantics remain unknown.

water_level.interpretation: Continuous target semantics, unit, sign, vertical datum, QC, and negative/extreme value meaning remain unresolved. Values were not removed or corrected.

potential_leakage_risks: Do not random-split this time series: nearby observations and overlapping target windows can leak temporal information across partitions.
Build future targets and lag/rolling predictors within an accepted stable gauge identity, after sorting by verified observation time; never use future or post-issue data in predictors.
Do not use source row numbers, SlNo, export order, fetched_at, or fields generated after the prediction issue time as predictors without a documented availability-time review.
Repeated station/timestamp records and revisions can leak or duplicate samples until provider resolution rules are reviewed.
Unknown station identity, time semantics, timezone, publication delay, and data revision timing prevent establishing what information would actually have been available at forecast issue time.

If the same gauges appear in train and test, results measure temporal generalization on known stations, not transfer to unseen stations; report a separate station-held-out evaluation after authoritative crosswalk review.

auxiliary_data_join_review.reason: The existing processed snapshot is a separate collection product. Its manifest does not establish an authoritative station crosswalk or validated temporal alignment to these historical raw files; its discharge field is entirely missing and rainfall is mostly missing. No join or feature was created.

candidate_forecasting_target.candidate_definition: For a provider-identified gauge, predict the valid measured water level at issue time + 60 minutes using only information available at issue time.
why_not_currently_justified: Data Acquisition Time semantics and timezone remain unresolved; naive timestamps cannot safely define an issue instant or future horizon.
Observed intervals include both shorter and longer than 60 minutes, so the next row is not reliably a one-hour-ahead target; interpolation/resampling would invent measurements.
Stable physical gauge IDs, duplicate/revision rules, units, sign, datum, QC, and negative/extreme-value semantics remain unresolved.
Observation coverage includes missing levels and large station-specific gaps; no provider coverage or operating-period evidence supports complete windows.
conditions_before_considering: Accept authoritative timestamp event semantics, timezone/clock rules, and stable station crosswalk.
Accept exact-resource water-level quantity, unit, sign and datum semantics, quality/sentinel rules, and duplicate/revision handling.
Define and domain-review a target-time matching tolerance and missing-target policy. Do not interpolate absent target values.
Demonstrate sufficient valid observations and coverage per station for the chosen horizon using only evidence-supported records.

evaluation_plan_if_later_approved.split: After all prerequisites are accepted, use globally chronological train/validation/test periods (initial proposal 70%/15%/15% by time, with boundaries fixed before evaluation). Assign rows by prediction issue time and purge any target window crossing a split boundary.
evaluation_plan_if_later_approved.embargo: Apply a temporal purge/embargo at least as long as the forecast horizon plus the maximum predictor lookback; establish exact duration after the feature contract is defined.
evaluation_plan_if_later_approved.station_grouping: Primary temporal evaluation may include the same verified gauges across periods and must be described as known-station generalization. Add a separate station-held-out group evaluation for unseen-station generalization only after station IDs are verified.
baselines_and_metrics: Persistence: latest valid same-gauge observation available strictly before issue time, with the same target-time eligibility rules as the model.
Seasonal naive only if authoritative cadence and matching historical horizon are established.
Compare against persistence using MAE and RMSE; report per-station as well as pooled metrics and sample counts. Report metric units only after measurement units are verified.
Do not use random splits or report a single metric without temporal coverage, missing-target, station composition, and baseline context.
